card.name: Magnifier
card.subject: A magnifying glass with a round silver rim, a clear lens with a white glint and a glossy red handle joined to the rim at its lower edge.
card.hero_colors: silver rim, clear glass with white glint, glossy red handle
card.note: The lens faces the viewer almost straight on, a near circle, and a short chunky handle, shorter than the lens is wide, runs down to the right in the same plane.
